title: Visitor badge
passage: Should I return this visitor badge now? A. Please leave it in the box by the exit. B. The visitor arrived early. C. It is your first visit.
passageZh:
我現在應該歸還訪客識別證嗎？
A. 請放進出口旁的盒子。
B. 訪客提早到了。
C. 這是你第一次來訪。
audioScript: Should I return this visitor badge now? A. Please leave it in the box by the exit. B. The visitor arrived early. C. It is your first visit.
